title: The displacement bridge: an overruling record embeds the overruled ratio
subject: displacement-bridge-embedding
ratio: (1) A rule displaced through the full overruling protocol leaves its author's standing intact; authorship credit and priority persist. (2) THE PROTOCOL CHANGE: every record published with an overrules relation must embed the overruled ratio verbatim together with its authorship (record id, published_by, issuing task) inside the superseding record, and a publish that does not is refused. (3) The embedded material is stored at relations[].overruled_predecessor, an object with exactly four keys record_id, ratio, published_by, issuing_task; the key is present on every relation object and null unless the relation type is overrules; it is an additive optional field, not a schema-version bump. (4) For a decision:T-NNN#anchor target there is no registry ratio and no published_by: the quoted predecessor text is supplied by the publisher, the issuing task is the T-NNN half of the anchor, and published_by is the fixed marker, verbatim: unavailable: decision-anchored target has no published_by. (5) The grandfather clause, verbatim: This rule is PROSPECTIVE: it governs publish calls made after this record publishes and reaches no record already in the registry. PR-009 is the worked ancestor this rule generalizes and is expressly not a counterexample to it: PR-009 published before the enforcement existed, and its overrule target is the task-anchored decision token decision:T-344#R-2, which has no registry ratio and no published_by to embed. PR-009 is not retrofitted: relations are immutable after publication under SDR-01, and the only immutability exception on record is the once-only schema migration, which alters no existing field's value. A future session that reads PR-009 as a counterexample to this rule is reading a record this ratio has already dispositioned. (6) The enforcement binds overrules ONLY; supersedes and voids are out of scope by this epic's own delimitation, named here rather than left to be discovered.
dicta: PR-009 is the worked ancestor this rule generalizes and is expressly NOT a counterexample to it: PR-009 published before this enforcement existed, and its overrule target decision:T-344#R-2 is a task-anchored decision token with no registry ratio and no published_by to embed. PR-009 is grandfathered by the prospective clause in this ratio; its relations are immutable under SDR-01 and are not edited by this record or by any task in this epic.
scope_conditions: publish calls carrying an overrules relation, made after this record publishes
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the relation grammar gains a fourth status-flipping type, or if a decision-anchored overrule target gains a resolvable authorship record
validity_conditions: precedent.py publish accepts --overrules with either a PR-NNN or a decision:T-NNN#anchor target
relation objects already carry per-relation optional keys that are present-but-null when unused
